Slide 7 ABB Rack PDU Solution What is a Rack PDU • In datacenters, a Rack PDU is a device (with multiple outlets) that distributes power to IT equipments in each individual cabinet and rack. • The purpose of a Rack PDU in networking is to provide a single power source to multiple devices, reducing the need for multiple power sources and simplifying cable management. • It is typically installed inside the server racks (at the back or side of the rack enclosure) • The Rack PDU is capable of monitoring, managing, and controlling power consumption to multiple devices in data center environments.
